description: Shared client primitives that every later UI feature depends on: new TypeScript types, the pure src/lib functions with unit tests (viewer-dependent glow, upcoming-assessment, month-grid, file validation, date-window), and the new theme tokens + AA harness. No UI wiring yet. Grounded in design.md 'New pure functions', 'New types', and 'New theme tokens' sections, mirroring derive.test.ts and palette-aa.test.ts.
steps: Extend src/lib/types.ts with: EventType/AbsenceReason/AbsenceStatus string-literal unions matching the enums; EventRow/EventItem (event_date/eventDate date-only 'YYYY-MM-DD'; start_time/end_time 'HH:MM:SS' | null); TaskCompletionRow/TaskCompletion (user_id/task_id/completed_at); AbsenceRequestRow/AbsenceRequest (subjectIds: string[], allClasses, enum fields, nullable officerRemark/reviewedBy/reviewedAt, optional studentName); AbsenceAttachmentRow/AbsenceAttachment; ReviewerRow/Reviewer (optional uploaderName); CalendarItem (kind 'task'|'event', type, title, id, datePart 'YYYY-MM-DD', startTime 'HH:MM:SS'|null, done flag for tasks) and MonthCell ({ dateYMD, inMonth, isToday }). Keep snake->camel convention + date-contract comments.

Extend src/lib/derive.ts: add subjectGlows(subjectId, tasks, viewer: { signedIn; completedTaskIds: Set<string> } | null) — null/signed-out delegates to subjectHasPending; signed-in glows iff >=1 pending task whose id is NOT in completedTaskIds. Keep subjectHasPending and its tests green. Add cases to src/lib/derive.test.ts: signed-out glows on any pending; signed-in glows only on unfinished pending; signed-in with only pending completed -> no glow; done tasks never glow; viewer null behaves as signed-out.

Create src/lib/events.ts + events.test.ts: hasUpcomingAssessment(subjectId, events: EventItem[], today = localTodayISO()) true iff some event matches subjectId, type in {quiz,exam,presentation} (school_event excluded), and today <= event_date <= today+7 inclusive; addDaysYMD(ymd, n) helper doing calendar math on 'YYYY-MM-DD' via UTC-midnight Date then reformatting (never leak a Date into comparisons). Tests: include quiz/exam/presentation, exclude school_event; boundaries today, +7 (included), +8 (excluded), yesterday (excluded); subject isolation; addDaysYMD month/year rollover.

Create src/lib/calendar.ts + calendar.test.ts: buildMonthGrid(year, month0, today) -> 42 MonthCell (6x7, Monday-first day 1=Mon..7=Sun, leading/trailing adjacent-month cells inMonth=false, isToday set); bucketItemsByDay(cells, items) -> Map<dateYMD, CalendarItem[]> (task keyed on deadlineDatePart, event on event_date); visibleWithOverflow(items, max=3) -> { shown, moreCount=max(0,len-max) }. Tests: Monday-first ordering, 42 cells, a month starting Sunday (max leading) and one starting Monday (zero leading), isToday detection, task-vs-event bucketing, overflow at exactly 3 (no +more), exactly 4 (moreCount 1), 0 items.

Create src/lib/storage.ts + storage.test.ts: SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS=60; EXCUSE_MIME=['application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png'], EXCUSE_MAX=5*1024*1024; REVIEWER_MIME (five types), REVIEWER_MAX=20*1024*1024; validateFile({type,size,name}, allowed, maxBytes) -> {ok:true}|{ok:false; reason:'type'|'size'}; buildStoragePath(userId, seg, fileName) -> `${userId}/${seg}/${safeName}`; sanitizeFileName(name) (strip path separators/.., collapse spaces, keep extension). Tests: type reject, size reject (exactly-at-limit passes, 1 byte over fails), ok case; sanitizeFileName strips / and ..; buildStoragePath shape.

Create src/lib/datewindow.ts + datewindow.test.ts: isValidRange(from, to) (to >= from, both 'YYYY-MM-DD'); rangeOverlaps(a, b). Tests: equal dates ok, reversed rejected; overlaps touching, nested, disjoint.

Add the new tokens to BOTH mode blocks in src/styles/tokens.css using design.md's starting hex: --ev-school/-fg, --ev-quiz/-fg, --ev-exam/-fg, --ev-pres/-fg; --status-pending/-fg, --status-ack/-fg, --status-followup/-fg; --task-done (= each mode's --muted value); --assess-badge/-fg. Do NOT modify theme-core.ts/resolveTokens.

Create src/lib/palette-ext-aa.test.ts importing ONLY contrastRatio and AA_NORMAL from theme-core (NOT DARK_BASE/LIGHT_BASE/resolveTokens). Assert over a literal in-file { mode, token, bg, fg } hex table mirroring tokens.css: every *-fg clears AA_NORMAL on its own bg; --task-done clears AA_NORMAL on --surface and --bg hex of that mode. If a pair fails, nudge the hex in BOTH tokens.css and the test table (kept identical) until green.
acceptance_criteria: All new types compile and are exported from src/lib/types.ts.

subjectGlows, hasUpcomingAssessment/addDaysYMD, buildMonthGrid/bucketItemsByDay/visibleWithOverflow, validateFile/buildStoragePath/sanitizeFileName, isValidRange/rangeOverlaps all exist and their co-located test suites pass with the boundary cases from design.md.
The new tokens exist in both mode blocks of tokens.css and palette-ext-aa.test.ts passes with every fg/bg pair >= AA_NORMAL; existing palette-aa.test.ts still passes.
verification: Run `npm run test` and confirm all new src/lib suites plus palette-ext-aa.test.ts pass, and the existing derive.test.ts and palette-aa.test.ts remain green.
Run `npm run typecheck` and confirm it passes.
Run `npm run build` and confirm it succeeds.
findings:
Exports for later features:

src/lib/types.ts — EventType ('school_event'|'quiz'|'exam'|'presentation'); AbsenceReason ('illness'|'family_emergency'|'school_activity'|'other'); AbsenceStatus ('pending'|'acknowledged'|'needs_followup'). Row/domain pairs: EventRow/EventItem (EventItem: id,title,type,subjectId,eventDate 'YYYY-MM-DD',startTime 'HH:MM:SS'|null,endTime 'HH:MM:SS'|null,location,notes,createdBy); TaskCompletionRow/TaskCompletion (userId,taskId,completedAt); AbsenceRequestRow/AbsenceRequest (AbsenceRequest: id,userId,dateFrom,dateTo,subjectIds string[],allClasses,reasonCategory,explanation,status,officerRemark|null,reviewedBy|null,reviewedAt|null,studentName?); AbsenceAttachmentRow/AbsenceAttachment (id,requestId,storagePath,fileName,mimeType,sizeBytes); ReviewerRow/Reviewer (Reviewer: id,uploaderId,subjectId,title,description,storagePath,fileName,mimeType,sizeBytes,createdAt,uploaderName?). CalendarItem { kind 'task'|'event', type EventType|TaskStatus, title, id, datePart 'YYYY-MM-DD', startTime 'HH:MM:SS'|null, done?:boolean }; MonthCell { dateYMD, inMonth, isToday }.

src/lib/derive.ts — subjectGlows(subjectId, tasks, viewer: { signedIn; completedTaskIds: Set<string> } | null). subjectHasPending retained.

src/lib/events.ts — hasUpcomingAssessment(subjectId, events: EventItem[], today = localTodayISO()); addDaysYMD(ymd, n).

src/lib/calendar.ts — buildMonthGrid(year, month0, today) => MonthCell[42]; bucketItemsByDay(cells, items) => Map<dateYMD, CalendarItem[]>; visibleWithOverflow(items, max=3) => { shown, moreCount }.

src/lib/storage.ts — SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS=60; EXCUSE_MIME, EXCUSE_MAX (5MB); REVIEWER_MIME (pdf,docx,pptx,jpeg,png), REVIEWER_MAX (20MB); validateFile(file,{type,size,name}, allowed, maxBytes) => {ok:true}|{ok:false,reason:'type'|'size'}; sanitizeFileName(name); buildStoragePath(userId, segment, fileName).

src/lib/datewindow.ts — DateRange {from,to}; isValidRange(from,to); rangeOverlaps(a: DateRange, b: DateRange).

tokens.css — new tokens in BOTH mode blocks: --ev-school/-fg, --ev-quiz/-fg, --ev-exam/-fg, --ev-pres/-fg, --status-pending/-fg, --status-ack/-fg, --status-followup/-fg, --task-done (=each mode's --muted), --assess-badge/-fg. All AA-verified by src/lib/palette-ext-aa.test.ts (table mirrors tokens.css; keep identical). theme-core.ts untouched. Verified: npm run test (152 passed/9 skipped), typecheck, build all green.
